welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: Learn how to set up Azahar and jump into emulation.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Grant the notification permission with the button below.
notifications.warningDescription: Azahar won't be able to notify you of important information.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.description: Grant the microphone permission below to emulate the 3DS microphone.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Grant the camera permission below to emulate the 3DS camera.

userDirectory.title: Select User Folder
userDirectory.description: Select your user data directory with the button below.
userDirectory.warningDescription: This step is required to allow Azahar to work. Please select a directory and then you can continue.

gamesDirectory.title: Applications
gamesDirectory.description: Select your Applications folder with the button below.
gamesDirectory.warningDescription: Software won't be displayed in the Applications list if a folder isn't selected.

done.title: Done
done.description:
You're all set.
Enjoy using the emulator!

general.title: General
general.frameLimitEnableDescription: When enabled, emulation speed will be limited to a specified percentage of normal speed.
general.frameLimitSliderDescription: Specifies the percentage to limit emulation speed. With the default of 100% emulation will be limited to normal speed. Values higher or lower will increase or decrease the speed limit.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.spirvShaderGenDescription: Emits the fragment shader used to emulate PICA using SPIR-V instead of GLSL
graphics.asyncShadersDescription: Compiles shaders in the background to reduce stuttering during gameplay. When enabled expect temporary graphical glitches
graphics.internalResolutionDescription: Specifies the resolution used to render at. A high resolution will improve visual quality a lot but is also quite heavy on performance and might cause glitches in certain applications.
graphics.linearFilteringDescription: Enables linear filtering, which causes game visuals to appear smoother.
graphics.shadersAccurateMulDescription: Uses more accurate multiplication in hardware shaders, which may fix some graphical bugs. When enabled, performance will be reduced.
graphics.useDiskShaderCacheDescription: Reduce stuttering by storing and loading generated shaders to disk. It cannot be used without Enabling Hardware Shader.
graphics.textureFilterDescription: Enhances the visuals of applications by applying a filter to textures. The supported filters are Anime4K Ultrafast, Bicubic, ScaleForce, xBRZ freescale, and MMPX.
graphics.delayRenderThreadDescription: Delay the game render thread when it submits data to the GPU. Helps with performance issues in the (very few) applications with dynamic framerates.
graphics.factor3dDescription: Specifies the value of the 3D slider. This should be set to higher than 0% when Stereoscopic 3D is enabled.
graphics.disableRightEyeRenderDescription: Greatly improves performance in some applications, but can cause flickering in others.
graphics.cardboardScreenSizeDescription: Scales the screen to a percentage of its original size.
graphics.cardboardXShiftDescription: Specifies the percentage of empty space to shift the screens horizontally. Positive values move the two eyes closer to the middle, while negative values move them away.
graphics.cardboardYShiftDescription: Specifies the percentage of empty space to shift the screens vertically. Positive values move the two eyes towards the bottom, while negative values move them towards the top.
graphics.dumpTexturesDescription: Textures are dumped to dump/textures/[Title ID]/.
graphics.customTexturesDescription: Textures are loaded from load/textures/[Title ID]/.
graphics.asyncCustomLoadingDescription: Load custom textures asynchronously with background threads to reduce loading stutter.
graphics.textureSamplingDescription: Overrides the sampling filter used by games. This can be useful in certain cases with poorly behaved games when upscaling. If unsure, set this to Game Controlled.
